mostWorthwhile.text: Using the spindle and then actin and myosin made nuclear separation and cytoplasmic division distinct stages, with a complete genome in each daughter cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: The membrane-building combination was straightforward, but the planned picture named the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi without explaining their roles in supplying membrane.

surprise.text: The spindle produced two daughter nuclei while the cytoplasm remained connected; a separate action was still needed to divide the cell.
